rationale: Third-party (neighbor's child) sustained bodily injury on your property due to an icy condition, creating a premises liability claim.
claim_summary: Nine-year-old neighbor's daughter slipped and fell on icy walkway in front of policyholder's house during last week's ice storm, sustaining a broken wrist. Medical bills are pending. High-severity pediatric injury claim requiring prompt adjuster investigation and coordination with family's medical providers.

case_facts.location: walkway in front of policyholder's house
case_facts.description: neighbor's child slipped on icy walkway
